name: Andrew Panasiuk
summary: Software Product engineer who takes features and epics from idea to production. I work alongside product, not just pick up tickets.
12+ years building native Android and iOS apps in code, used by 1M+ people.
Today I build with AI coding agents by default (Claude Code, Cursor). I own the problem and its solution and design the process. Agents run it, and quality gates keep it stable.
M.Sc. in Applied Mathematics trained me to reason about complex systems.
Comfortable across the stack, from mobile to backend and web.
Ready to build new products or bring an AI-native approach into an existing codebase.

craft.label: 2012 → before AI
craft.title: 12 years of native apps, written by hand
craft.text: Kotlin and Java on Android, Swift and UIKit on iOS. BLE device sync, offline-first architecture, custom graphics, SDKs, MVVM/MVI, CI from scratch. I know what good code looks like. That's why I can judge what agents produce.

craft.label: now → with agents
craft.title: The process is the product I engineer
craft.text: Spec → prototype → ship → iterate. I frame the problem, decompose the work, set contracts and guardrails, and parallel agent sessions deliver. Agent-first features with LLMs are grounded, tested with evals and cost-controlled.

loop.lead: The development process is a system with feedback. I design the loop. Autonomous coding agents run it.

steps.text: I frame the epic and decide open questions
Orchestrator breaks it into Linear tickets
CI, e2e and post-deploy checks as arbiter

loop.footnote: every retro lands as a PR to the rules, so the process improves itself

impact.text: users on each of Cync and August Home. I shipped key features in both smart-home apps.
Dolphin Music runs on Android and iOS from one Kotlin Multiplatform codebase with about 830 tests.
Two AI features, a grounded chat and a page agent, went from architecture to delivery in 14 agent sessions.

personal.about: Voice-first music producer. Describe a mood by voice and an AI composer writes a looping track. Reshape it by talking while it plays.
points: Built on ElevenLabs Agents (Android and Swift SDKs) and the Eleven Music API. Kotlin Multiplatform and Compose Multiplatform share one UI and one domain layer across both platforms.
Live section edits with no gap. Only the edited section is regenerated with reference context. It is checked for seam similarity and swapped into the looping PCM with equal-power crossfades.
Voice agent with typed client tools for compose, edit section, global style and undo. Music ducks sample-accurately while anyone speaks.
Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) proxy the ElevenLabs APIs, so keys never ship in the app. The private agent takes per-session tokens. Access codes live in Keystore and Keychain.

Built agent-first with TDD. About 830 tests cover the domain, Robolectric, Roborazzi screenshots, Konsist architecture rules and the proxy. CI runs on Android and the iOS simulator, and a tag releases a signed APK.

personal.about: Interactive CV with an AI chat and page agent.
points: Shipped an LLM chat that answers strictly from CV data. It has streaming, prompt caching, grounding and prompt-injection guardrails.
Architected a page agent on the same chat. The model controls the site through typed tools, and it is WebMCP-ready.
Designed a multi-agent workflow with an orchestrator, up to 3 parallel sessions, strict file ownership and CI as arbiter. Packaged it as a reusable template. ~263 tests, zero real LLM calls in CI.

projects.name: SpotOn
points: Unified 200+ color resources into a design system across 8 multi-module projects with AI-assisted refactoring. Took 3 days vs. ~2 weeks and simplified dark mode.

Built complex custom graphics with Jetpack Compose Canvas to drive user engagement.

jobs.about: App for apartment management, built from scratch.

jobs.about: SaaS for events with branded mobile apps.
points: Switched from Android to iOS when the iOS app was falling behind. Closed the feature gap and brought both platforms to feature parity (Swift, UIKit).
Shipped features in 2 key products in close loop with design, with daily CI builds. Led the Kotlin migration on Android.
With no dedicated QA, I owned release quality end-to-end, from testing and regressions to stable production builds.

Built localization SDK features. Raised unit-test coverage to 60%+, published via Maven and wrote SDK docs.

points: Built an unusual search UX for flights and hotels.
Regular bug-free releases. Mentored 2 developers and owned a shared codebase for 3 apps.
Introduced Agile for faster delivery and tighter feedback from the PO.

jobs.about: Internal tool that automated work 20 developers were repeating by hand.
points: Early in my career got the green light to work independently on an internal library. It was an analogue of Android LayoutInflater for a custom UI framework.
